# pvecli backup notes

Set the notes of a backup.

```text
pvecli backup notes VOLID TEXT [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VOLID` | Backup volume. |
| `TEXT` | New notes (empty string to clear). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-n`, `--node VALUE` | Node to go through (default: the node holding the backup). |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
